description: Spaces. Counts for a specific hospital live in catalog/hospitals/<id>.yaml; positions in the layout file. Target sources: CMS Provider of Services, HCRIS cost reports, FGI design guidelines, literature for turnaround.

ward_bed_open_delay_days.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Time to staff and open a block of inpatient beds; placeholder

ward_bed_open_cost.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): One-off cost per inpatient bed opened (fit-out, recruitment); placeholder

bay_close_cost.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): One-off cost per treatment bay closed (decommissioning); placeholder

walk_path_factor.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Walking distance = rectilinear (corridor) distance between room centres x this

relocate_reduced_triage_stations.citation: Simulator model parameter (added by sim/): Triage stations usable while triage is being relocated; placeholder

walk_speed_m_per_min.citation: Bohannon RW (1997) Comfortable and maximum walking speed of adults aged 20-79 years: reference values and determinants, Age and Ageing 26(1):15-19 (abstract): mean comfortable gait speed 127.2 cm/s (women in their seventies) to 146.2 cm/s (men in their forties), n = 230 healthy volunteers; maximum 174.9 to 253.3 cm/s.
walk_speed_m_per_min.note: Healthy adults over a 7.62 m walkway, not staff in a hospital corridor; working-age adults sit near 80-88 m/min. Hurrying staff can reach 105-150 m/min (the maximum-speed figures).

fixed_cost_per_hour.citation: Calibrated, split assumed: overhead allocated to the Emergency cost centre = Worksheet B Part I line 91 column 26 minus Worksheet A line 91 column 7 = 37834167 usd/year (CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024), spread over the modelled ED spaces {'triage': 3, 'treatment_bay': 68, 'resus_bay': 6, 'fast_track': 10, 'peds_ed': 17, 'results_waiting': 1} for 8784 hours using the Wave 0 relative weights (this space type 1.0417); scale factor 15.92
fixed_cost_per_hour.note: The annual total is measured; how it divides between space types is assumed, hence the 'assumed' tag. Wave 0 placeholder was 1.0417.

turnaround_min.citation: University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, 'Accelerating Care: Spotless Turnover to Smooth Handover', SHM Converge 2026 abstract 692: mean time from environmental-services cleaning request to room cleaned, inspected and released to bed control fell from 115 min (Feb 2023-Feb 2024) to 68 min (Jan-Jun 2025). Ankrum AL et al. (2019) Infect Control Hosp Epidemiol 40(10): isolation-room turnover median 130 min (range 93-294) cut to 65 min (48-95); cleaning and curtain change itself 57 to 37 min.
turnaround_min.note: Inpatient discharge cleans at a cancer centre (conference abstract, sample size not reported) and a children's hospital (isolation rooms with UV disinfection). Value = the post-improvement mean; unimproved hospitals sit near 115-130 min. No published figure was found for emergency department bay turnaround, which stays assumed. Second URL: https://doi.org/10.1017/ice.2019.199
